READ-ONLY SEO AUDIT · STRATFORD, CT

The Dental Club — SEO audit

Five verified issues and the next fix for each.

October 1, 2026 · 63 unique sitemap URLs checked · selected live-page, GBP and Google evidence

01

Treatment pages use unsuitable Product markup

Eight sampled treatment pages expose Product markup with a nonnumeric “$$-$$$” price and the same practice review reused as a treatment review.

  • Remove the Product, Offer, rating and review template from treatment pages unless genuine treatment-specific data supports it.
  • Keep accurate Service markup and validate the rendered JSON-LD across all pages using the template.
8 of 8 sampled service pages: Product + Service JSON-LD
AggregateOffer.price = $$-$$$; numeric lowPrice absent
One practice review and ratingCount 24 repeated

Example: Veneers page

02

Business schema gives conflicting hours

The homepage publishes two Dentist entities for the same practice, but one lists Saturday hours and the other does not.

  • Use one stable Dentist business ID with the hours, address and phone verified against the Google Business Profile.
  • Have interior Service pages reference that same business ID.
Homepage Dentist node A: Monday–Wednesday, 08:00–17:00
Homepage Dentist node B: Monday–Wednesday plus Saturday, 09:00–14:00
Live GBP: Monday–Wednesday 08:00–17:00; Thursday–Sunday closed

Homepage source

03

Area pages repeat most of their body copy

Five city pages have different introductions but reuse 41 identical paragraph and list blocks, representing about 67–69% of each page’s paragraph/list text.

  • Keep pages that answer distinct local needs, and replace repeated catalogue text with verified city-specific access, travel or patient information.
  • Review each page’s search intent before expanding or removing it.
Pages reviewed: Bridgeport, Fairfield, Milford, Shelton and Trumbull
41 identical paragraph/list blocks across all five
04

The emergency tile does not open the emergency page

The homepage shows a “Same-Day Emergency” treatment tile as plain text even though a live Emergency Dentist page exists.

  • Link that tile directly to the Emergency Dentist page.
  • Check the other unlinked treatment tiles for matching live destinations.
Same-Day Emergency element: H3 with no parent anchor
Existing page: /emergency-dentist/
05

Teeth-cleaning searches rarely reach the page

The indexed teeth-cleaning page appeared 4,011 times in September Google web results but received no clicks at an average position of 16.8.

  • Review the page against local “teeth cleaning near me” intent and add verified Stratford-specific usefulness where needed.
  • Strengthen relevant internal links, then monitor query and page performance after changes.
This does not prove a title/snippet fault or lost leads.

Fix order

Clean up inaccurate structured data first, then improve the area-page and service journeys.

  • First: Product and Dentist schema templates across affected pages.
  • Next: local-page differentiation, the emergency tile and the teeth-cleaning page.

Selected findings only. No reliable Core Web Vitals score was available because PageSpeed hit quota and CrUX returned 403; click events are not qualified leads. No site changes were made.
